_doc: Cycle E v18 baseline judge profiles.  Selected via env var AMOR_SPRINT0_JUDGE (default: mistral).  Each profile maps to a llama-server CPU container started by select_and_start.sh.  Add a profile by extending this JSON; no code change required.

mistral.label: Mistral-Small-3-24B-Instruct (Q4_K_M, CPU)
mistral.rationale: Family-distinct from Qwen-derived AMOR architect (Panickssery 2024 self-correlation guard).  CPU-only run is slow (~1-2 hours per 10-prompt × position-swap × 2-rubric pass) but kalitatif olarak en bağımsız judge.  Default for the v18 baseline.

phi4.label: Phi-4-14B-Instruct (Q4_K_M, CPU)
phi4.rationale: Lighter fallback for Mistral.  ~30 min per pass on CPU.  Use when (a) host RAM cannot host 16 GB Mistral container, OR (b) you need to ship the baseline in a single working day rather than overnight.  Less independent judge validation but adequate for triangulation.

mistral_fast.label: Mistral-Small-3-24B-Instruct (Q3_K_M, CPU, fast-prefill)
mistral_fast.rationale: Q3_K_M trades ~1.5pp judgment fidelity for ~30% prefill speedup.  Use when the full Q4_K_M run cannot fit a single overnight window AND Phi-4's family-overlap with Qwen-derived candidates is concerning.
